review.reason: 리뷰 거절: server:1 (binary blob) — commit 9d81c75, whose stated scope is only the Retry-After header fix, also adds a 20,911,024-byte compiled ELF x86-64 Go binary named `server`. `file` reports it is dynamically linked, 'with debug_info, not stripped', and `strings` shows it was built without -trimpath from this worktree, so it embeds absolute local build paths (/home/hkjang/.cache/auto-improve-wt/appstore/cmd/server/main.go, .../internal/crypto/secret.go, etc.). This is a stray local `go build` artifact swept in by a blanket `git add`; it is completely unrelated to the diff's purpose (범위 이탈). / server:1 — the binary is not ignored anywhere: .gitignore lists `/appstore` but not `/server` (`git check-ignore -v server` exits 1), so the artifact will silently reappear in future commits. .dockerignore likewise ignores `appstore` but not `server`, and the Dockerfile go-build stage does `COPY . ./`, so the 20MB blob is shipped into the Docker build context and the builder layer on every image build. / server:1 — this is not cleanly revertable (되돌리기 어려움). `git revert` deletes the file from the tree but the 20MB blob stays in main's history forever once merged; removing it requires a history rewrite (filter-repo/BFG) and a force-push coordinated with every clone. A merge is therefore a one-way door for repository size.

reasons: server:1 (binary blob) — commit 9d81c75, whose stated scope is only the Retry-After header fix, also adds a 20,911,024-byte compiled ELF x86-64 Go binary named `server`. `file` reports it is dynamically linked, 'with debug_info, not stripped', and `strings` shows it was built without -trimpath from this worktree, so it embeds absolute local build paths (/home/hkjang/.cache/auto-improve-wt/appstore/cmd/server/main.go, .../internal/crypto/secret.go, etc.). This is a stray local `go build` artifact swept in by a blanket `git add`; it is completely unrelated to the diff's purpose (범위 이탈).

server:1 — the binary is not ignored anywhere: .gitignore lists `/appstore` but not `/server` (`git check-ignore -v server` exits 1), so the artifact will silently reappear in future commits. .dockerignore likewise ignores `appstore` but not `server`, and the Dockerfile go-build stage does `COPY . ./`, so the 20MB blob is shipped into the Docker build context and the builder layer on every image build.

server:1 — this is not cleanly revertable (되돌리기 어려움). `git revert` deletes the file from the tree but the 20MB blob stays in main's history forever once merged; removing it requires a history rewrite (filter-repo/BFG) and a force-push coordinated with every clone. A merge is therefore a one-way door for repository size.

internal/httpapi/spa_test.go:65 — TestSPAFontsAreTypedWithoutASystemMimeTable does not verify what commit f7aaeac claims it pins ('a web font is still named as one on the Alpine runtime'). The only handler assertion is `if got != "" && !strings.Contains(got, "woff2")`, which passes when Content-Type is empty — i.e. exactly the Alpine/no-mime.types case the test is named after. The remaining assertion (spa_test.go:72) calls http.DetectContentType on bytes read straight from spa.dist, exercising the stdlib rather than SPAHandler.serveFile. The test passes unchanged if serveFile's Content-Type logic (spa.go:47-56) is deleted entirely, so it asserts nothing about the code under test.
notes: The Retry-After logic itself is correct. retryAfterSeconds (internal/httpapi/ratelimit.go:68-76) truncates in UTC, matching the window computed by fixedWindowLimiter.allow (ratelimit.go:33), rounds up so the advertised instant never precedes the reset, and TestRetryAfterSecondsOutlastsTheRejectingWindow (ratelimit_test.go:73-88) actually drives the limiter and re-checks at the advertised time across the whole minute. Timezone case included. No off-by-one found.

internal/httpapi/ratelimit.go:72 — the `if seconds < 1 { return 1 }` guard is dead: remaining is always in (0, 60], so seconds is always in [1, 60]. Harmless, but the `int((remaining + time.Second - 1) / time.Second)` int-truncation of a Duration is a bit obscure; time.Duration.Round/Ceil would read better.

internal/httpapi/auth_handlers.go:62 — the bootstrap login limiter still answers a flat Retry-After: 60 while the two middlewares now compute it. The commit message discloses this deliberately ('left alone for now: it is answered to the browser form'), so it is not a mismatch between message and code, but it does leave three call sites of the same limiter with two different behaviours.

No auth/permission/payment/migration/secret/deletion logic is touched by the source diff; the middleware and SPA commits are test-only additions. All new tests pass locally (`go test ./internal/httpapi/ -run 'TestSPA|TestRetryAfter|TestRequestID|TestSecurityHeaders|TestRecoverer|TestAccessLog|TestNoStore|TestFixedWindow'` → ok). The SPA tests depend on internal/webui/dist, which is tracked in git, so they will not break the CI ordering (go test runs before the npm build step).
No secrets found in the committed binary (scanned for APPSTORE_* assignments, postgres DSNs with credentials, sk-* keys — none present). The leak is limited to local filesystem paths.

Recommended fix before re-review: `git rm --cached server`, add `/server` to .gitignore and `server` to .dockerignore, and rewrite 9d81c75 so the blob never enters history; separately, tighten spa_test.go:65 to assert the Content-Type the handler is actually expected to produce (or drop the claim from the commit message).
